decision: The targeted correction closes the flush-before-owned-detach loss window and replaces the source-only readiness claim with executed production-helper fixtures, but the explicitly required setup-close-plus-timeout path still overwrites runtime-error with setup-error. Stop this correction/review cycle and use the bounded revised approach below.

targeted_findings.title: Setup timeout overwrites a previously observed unexpected-session-close runtime error
evidence: tools/ui/cdp_network_collector.cjs:284-287 records unexpected-session-close through failClosed, which sets status to runtime-error.
tools/ui/cdp_network_collector.cjs:610-617 handles awaitReady timeout by unconditionally assigning setup-error.

tests/cdp_network_collector.test.ts:213-232 emits close but then resolves Target.getTargetInfo, so setup rejects through the catch path before timeout and does not test the combined close-plus-timeout path.
targeted_findings.impact: When the target closes while Target.getTargetInfo or Network.enable remains unresolved until the setup deadline, the retained artifact loses the contract-required runtime-error classification even though unexpected-session-close remains in the inconsistency list.
targeted_findings.revised_approach: In the awaitReady timeout branch, preserve runtime-error when unexpectedSessionClosed is already true, while retaining setup timeout metadata. Add one focused production-helper test that leaves Target.getTargetInfo or Network.enable unresolved, emits close, lets awaitReady reach its deadline, finalizes, and asserts runtime-error plus unexpected-session-close. Do not rerun unrelated broad evidence.

resolved_findings.title: Flush-before-owned-detach lifecycle window
resolved_findings.evidence: Network ingestion now stops separately while the session-close listener and external failClosed path remain active until detachStarted; the focused test holds body settlement open and proves both session-close and external-frame-loss remain runtime-error.

resolved_findings.title: Collector-owned detach and disabled mode
resolved_findings.evidence: detachStarted is set before session.detach, so its close event is ignored; idempotent finalization remains covered, and disabled lifecycle installs no guards or collector.

resolved_findings.title: Fresh/resume readiness ordering
resolved_findings.evidence: resolveGameplayFrameAndStartCdpCollection is extracted from production and executed for fresh and resume fixtures; both record frame resolution, lifecycle construction, and awaited readiness before the first caller action with no Advance/turn dispatch.

focused_tests.limitation: The passing set does not contain the combined unexpected-close followed by setup-timeout case.
